title: The show begins in the directory
governingQuestion: Which databases connect a New York idea to the people and materials that can make it?
status: evidence-backed draft; recording, named interviews and owner-final approval remain open
hook: The show starts upstream—in the databases that connect ideas to makers and materials.

longform.headline: The show begins in the directory
longform.opening: The show starts upstream—in the databases that connect ideas to makers and materials. The evidence reveals a system of coordination rather than a single machine.

sections.heading: Manufacturing as search
sections.copy: CFDA says its Fashion Manufacturing Initiative began with NYCEDC in 2013 to support New York City fashion manufacturing.

sections.heading: Materials as a database
sections.copy: CFDA’s current open Production Directory lists more than 380 U.S. manufacturers, while its Materials Hub connects users to material innovators, vendors and resources.

sections.heading: Show-to-sales infrastructure
sections.copy: Neither directory proves which supplier, ordering or wholesale system a September 2026 collection actually uses; those links require brand-level reporting.
